recording_stopped.title: Recording stopped
recording_stopped.effect: qui cannot write the transfer history. It tries again at the next write.
recording_stopped.fix: Make sure that the disk has free space and that qui can write its database file.
recording_stopped.menuFix: Free disk space for the database

shrink_failed.title: Shrink failed
shrink_failed.effect: qui could not make the database file smaller. The database did not change, and qui runs as usual.
shrink_failed.fix: The qui log has the details.

disk_full.fix: The disk has too little free space. A shrink needs up to two times the size of the database file. Free space on the disk, then try again.
disk_full.menuFix: Free disk space, then try again

locked.fix: Another program held the database file. Stop that program, for example a backup tool or a database viewer, then try again.
locked.menuFix: Stop the other program, then try again

low_disk.title: Low disk
low_disk.effect: The disk of the qui database has little free space. When the disk is full, each write of qui fails.
low_disk.fix: Free space on the disk, lower "Keep daily detail for", or delete older history in the Statistics settings.
low_disk.menuFix: Free disk space for the database

redacted_key_rejected.title: Redacted rejected the API key
redacted_key_rejected.effect: Redacted rejected the last search. qui asks it again at the next search.
redacted_key_rejected.fix: If the key is wrong, make an API key with the Torrents permission in your Redacted profile settings, and paste it in the Gazelle (OPS/RED) settings of qui. If Redacted banned the IP of qui, a new key does not help: contact the staff of Redacted.
redacted_key_rejected.menuFix: Paste a new key in settings

orpheus_key_rejected.title: Orpheus rejected the API key
orpheus_key_rejected.effect: Orpheus rejected the last search. qui asks it again at the next search.
orpheus_key_rejected.fix: If the key is wrong, make an API key with the Torrents permission in your Orpheus profile settings, and paste it in the Gazelle (OPS/RED) settings of qui. If Orpheus banned the IP of qui, a new key does not help: contact the staff of Orpheus.
orpheus_key_rejected.menuFix: Paste a new key in settings

library_scan_schedule_blocked.title: Library Scan schedule cannot run
library_scan_schedule_blocked.effect: qui cannot start the scheduled Library Scan run. It tries again every hour.
library_scan_schedule_blocked.fix: Check the Library Scan settings. qui tries again every hour.

torznab_off_no_gazelle.fix: Torznab is off in the Library Scan settings, and no RED or OPS API key is set. Turn Torznab on, or add a RED or OPS key in the Gazelle (OPS/RED) settings. qui tries again every hour.
torznab_off_no_gazelle.menuFix: Turn Torznab on, or add a RED or OPS key

no_indexer.fix: No indexer is enabled. Enable a Torznab indexer, or add a RED or OPS key in the Gazelle (OPS/RED) settings. qui tries again every hour.

instance_missing.fix: The instance in the saved Library Scan settings does not exist. Pick an instance in the Library Scan settings, then save. qui tries again every hour.

unknown.title: System notice
unknown.effect: qui found a fault that needs an action from you.
unknown.fix: The qui log has the details.
